contexts.text: Thou shalt burn upon the altar () = from the Lord's Divine love. To burn = the kindling of the Divine love... because the fire on the altar = the Divine love.
To burn () = to unite to the Divine good of the Divine love.

The reason to burn on the altar with the whole ram = to unite the Divine good of the Divine love with the Internal of His Human, is that the altar was the representative of the Lord's Divine Human, and the fire upon the altar with which the burnt-offering was burnt signified the Divine good of the Divine love; and that the ram which was the burnt-offering, and which was burnt = the internal with man, thus the internal of the Lord's Human. AC 10084.
